Input

3 calls on vupp, generated from the firmware. Every one exists on the device exactly as written here.

Read the pad every frame; there is no event queue.

vupp.btn

vupp.btn(b) -> bool

engine v7

Is button b held right now? One of "up", "down", "left", "right", "a", "b", "select"; an unknown name raises. "start" never reaches an app, because the engine owns it for the pause menu (engine v7). There is no event queue: read the pad every frame.

vupp.btnp

vupp.btnp(b) -> bool

Was b pressed on THIS frame? The edge, not the level. Jumping, firing and moving a menu cursor want this one; walking wants vupp.btn, and using btn where btnp belongs is why a menu selection flies past six entries on one press.

vupp.touch

vupp.touch() -> nil | {x, y, held} in canvas coordinates

capability: touch

Held is true the whole time a finger is down (apps do their own press-edge detection). Only injected when the manifest declares the "touch" capability.

Generated from firmware/vupp/components/apprt/vupp_apprt_api.c at engine v17. Back to the SDK.
